title: Rescaled algebraic spectra can coincide for distinct geometries

failure: R16 distinguished two models with different fields, but that observation does not prove universal inverse uniqueness. R17 gives distinct pentagon and decagon walks whose normalized spectra coincide exactly; absolute norm and collision mass still distinguish these models.
correction: Derive the difference lattice independently of the original endpoint lattice. Compare the complete normalized spectra and retain an independently defined dynamical collision statistic.
transfer: When using a signature for identification, explicitly state which calibration or absolute scales are retained. Search for isomorphic quotients after normalization, then add a complementary observable if the signature loses distinctions.
limits: Two specified uniform unit polygon walks; exact spectrum identity with 5000 norm comparisons, 500 rescaled comparisons and 2401 multiplication checks.
